dedupe_keys.name: precon pakistan residential electricity consumption dataset

description: PRECON Pakistan Residential Electricity Consumption Dataset is a dataset listed in Open Data Pakistan portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by The Energy Informatics Group (EIG). PRECON is a first of its kind extensive dataset of electricity consumption patterns of users in developing countries. The dataset has been collected through smart meters over a period of one year and comprise of data of users belonging to different demographics and different social and financial backgrounds. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher The Energy Informatics Group (EIG). Its tags are Electricity Consumption, Energy Demand, Residential Load. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv, html, pdf, zip. The portal shows 2021-04-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CCZero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-pk-od-portal.
